pages.text: Chests, barrels, shulker boxes and ender chests open their usual screens on the wagon. Each cargo chest provides independent storage.$(br2)Conversion preserves cargo positions and container contents. Reopen storage menus after conversion finishes.

Unloading or destroying an ordinary container drops its block and contents separately. Shulker boxes retain their contents; ender chests access personal storage.$(br2)Compatible modded chests and barrels work too. Unlock containers and resolve their loot before transporting them as interactive cargo.
